areas.ag: Imperial County Air Pollution Control District
areas.t: Today, atmospheric mixing will decrease as an upper-level ridge of high pressure aloft approaches from the north. Furthermore, light and variable winds will hinder dispersion in the Imperial Valley throughout the day. However, pollutant carryover will be low, allowing AQI levels to remain high-Good.
